title: Improved Data Processing & Workspace Persistence
description: Major overhaul of Excel parsing logic for complex spreadsheets, combined with connection-aware workspace persistence and enhanced data preview tools.

items.title: Robust Excel Engine
items.description: A complete rewrite of our Excel parser using ExcelJS for extreme reliability with complex financial reports.
details: Added support for formulas (calculates results instead of showing strings)
Handles rich text and merged cells seamlessly
Automatic multi-row header detection: intelligently combines parent categories with detail columns
Integrated confidence scoring (0-1) to detect and flag potentially problematic parses
Advanced post-processing to identify real headers buried under title rows

items.title: Enhanced Data Preview
items.description: Improved tools for exploring large datasets directly in the browser.
details: Added local pagination controls (Page X of Y) for instant data navigation
Adjustable rows per page: switch between 10, 25, and 50 rows per view
Showing X of Y records count for better dataset visibility
Performance optimizations for rendering hundreds of columns in the preview modal

items.title: Workspace Persistence
items.description: Tabs (chats, spreadsheets, queries) are now saved per database connection.
details: Tabs automatically restore when switching back to a connection
Real-time state synchronization with backend persistence
Auto-save mechanism to prevent data loss

items.title: Sidebar Improvements
items.description: Enhanced navigation with a new toggle in the connection list.
details: Switch between database table view and saved tabs view
Manage active tabs directly from the sidebar
Compact TabList component for quick switching

items.title: Migration & Safety
items.description: Ensuring data integrity during workspace transitions.
details: Visual warning when working in the Temporary Workspace
Migration dialog prompts to move or discard unsaved tabs when switching connections

items.title: Infrastructure Upgrades
items.description: Backend services expanded to handle complex data state.
details: Migrated backend parsing from custom XML logic to ExcelJS
Connection-workspaces database table for persistent storage
Metadata return support for parsing confidence and warnings
